title: Find a station and read its card
summary: The Recruit's first job, and Graham shows him: the search, a station's card — whose it is, its health, its plots — and the way in.

scenes.title: Find a station and read its card
scenes.line: The search, a station's card, and the way in.
scenes.say: First day, and they've asked me to check on a station. Where do I even start?

scenes.title: Search for it
scenes.sub: Up in the banner, on every tab
scenes.say: Start with the search up top. Type a name, a station number or an ALERT address, and pick it from the list.

scenes.title: Its card
scenes.sub: Whose it is, and its health
scenes.say: That opens its card on the map. First, whose station it is; then its health: when it was last heard, and anything wrong.

callouts.text: When it was last heard, and anything wrong

scenes.title: Its readings
scenes.say: And how do I see what it's been reading?

scenes.title: Its plots
scenes.sub: The river, and the rain round it
scenes.say: Under Data: its readings, every gauge on the same river, and the rain gauges round it, each a plot a press away.

callouts.text: Its readings, and its neighbours', plotted

scenes.title: The way in
scenes.say: Further down, the way in: directions to it, and Street View and Google Earth to see it before you go.

scenes.title: Already out there?
scenes.say: What if I'm already out there?

scenes.title: Nearby
scenes.say: Then Nearby lists the stations closest to where you're standing. Press one, and it's the same card.

scenes.title: That's the job
scenes.say: That's the job. Now have a go yourself: press Show me on the app, and I'll walk you through it.
scenes.line: Might as well do it properly.
